TIMELINE_NOTES.Settings.CampaignCalendar: The calendar adapter used by Timeline Notes. The default is simplified Gregorian.
TIMELINE_NOTES.Settings.CampaignCurrentD: The campaign date used as the default start date for new timeline notes.
TIMELINE_NOTES.Settings.CampaignCurrentT: The campaign time used as the default start time for new timeline notes.
TIMELINE_NOTES.Settings.EnablePrimaryDoc: Registers the experimental TimelineNote document candidate during init. Enable only in a test world, then reload Foundry before running the create test.
